body: One page, from the CEO to everyone, by Friday noon.
In it: good news, the numbers, priority status and a positive close.
The first one goes this week.
notes: New today: the CEO starts the weekly email this week.
The numbers are the company metrics or the critical number.
Team members send their status by Thursday noon.
